name: @sauce/swap
description: SauceScript swaps whose route a service builds when the program compiles: `kyber` runs KyberSwap's router calldata, `eco` evaluates an eco-swap program. A program writes `kyberSwap(...)`/`ecoSwap(...)`, which the SDK's host lowers to these with the route put in. `main` names the NEUTRAL BASE the compiler suffixes per target (swap.evm.js); there is no SVM arm, because both providers' routes are EVM calls.
